ios.desc: Unlock the power of visual representation with ASCII Chart generator, the must-have app for turning numerical data into stunning ASCII art charts! Whether you’re a data enthusiast, coder, or just someone who loves visualizing numbers, this app is your go-to tool.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Generate ASCII Charts on iOS

quotes.text:
After having seen some charts made with text, I had the urge to create a chart generator that could run on iOS.
After having converted the great asciichart from Python to Swift, I've created a small utility app using SwiftUI & SwiftData.

Here is an example of chart generated from the app:

  18┼╮                   
  17┤│                   
  15┤╰╮                  
  14┤ │  ╭╮╭╮            
  12┤ ╰──╯│││            
  10┤     ╰╯╰╮           
 8,8┤        │      ╭╮ ╭╴
 7,2┤        │  ╭─╮╭╯╰╮│ 
 5,6┤        ╰╮╭╯ ││  ││ 
   4┤         ││  ╰╯  ╰╯ 
 2,5┼         ╰╯         

Would be happy to answer your questions & suggestions!
